{{Top}}
'''Target blasters''' were [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] with powerful [[stun]] settings popular among politicians and diplomats.<ref name="RotSVisual">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
[[File:Bail_Organa_blaster.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Bail Organa's target blaster]]
Small, but precise and powerful similar to [[Sporting blaster/Legends|sporting blaster]]s, target blasters differed from sporting blasters in that they had powerful stun settings, and could be used as a heavy [[Stun blaster/Legends|stun blaster]] to subdue would-be attackers.<ref name="RotSVisual" /> At least some target blasters were modified to only fire non-lethal blasts.<ref name="CHARENCYCLO">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> These potent non-lethal features made them popular with politicians and diplomats who carried target blasters for unprofessional and minimal usage, as well as among others of good reputation, such as city-dwellers and ship captains.<ref name="RotSVisual" /><ref name="CHARENCYCLO" />

==History==
[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] used a target blaster that was modified to fire only stun blasts during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CHARENCYCLO" />
